items.title: Battery State-of-Charge Device
items.description: Configuration for one battery state-of-charge calculation.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier used in MQTT topics and Home Assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Human-readable name for the battery state-of-charge device.

via_device.title: Parent device
via_device.description: Home Assistant device identifier that provides the battery telemetry.

system_type.title: System type
system_type.description: AC-coupled: charger and/or inverter are measured on the mains (AC) side, optionally refined by DC measurements. Typical for grid-connected home batteries. DC-only: all power or current measurements sit on the battery's DC bus. Typical for embedded devices.

charger_dc_power_topic.title: Charger DC power topic
charger_dc_power_topic.description: Power or current flowing into the battery on its DC bus. If an AC charger input is set too, a fresh DC reading replaces it.

charger_dc_power_json_key.title: Charger DC power JSON key
charger_dc_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing DC charger power. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number.

charger_dc_power_unit.title: Charger DC unit
charger_dc_power_unit.description: Unit of the DC charging reading. Choose A for a current sensor, the service converts it to watts with the pack voltage.

charger_dc_power_invert.title: Invert charger DC power
charger_dc_power_invert.description: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging. Negative values are ignored on each side.

inverter_dc_power_topic.title: Inverter DC power topic
inverter_dc_power_topic.description: Power or current flowing out of the battery on its DC bus. If an AC inverter input is set too, a fresh DC reading replaces it.

inverter_dc_power_json_key.title: Inverter DC power JSON key
inverter_dc_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing DC inverter power. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number.

inverter_dc_power_unit.title: Inverter DC unit
inverter_dc_power_unit.description: Unit of the DC discharging reading. Choose A for a current sensor, the service converts it to watts with the pack voltage.

inverter_dc_power_invert.title: Invert inverter DC power
inverter_dc_power_invert.description: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for discharging and (inverted) for charging. Negative values are ignored on each side.

bank_a_voltage_topic.title: Bank A voltage topic
bank_a_voltage_topic.description: Voltage of bank A, from A+ to A-. With a single bank, this is the pack voltage.

bank_a_voltage_json_key.title: Bank A voltage JSON key
bank_a_voltage_json_key.description: JSON property containing battery bank A voltage.

bank_a_voltage_scale.title: Bank A voltage scale
bank_a_voltage_scale.description: Correction factor for the sensor (e.g. a voltage divider). Leave at 1.0 when the sensor reports the real pack voltage. The per-cell conversion happens via the cell count.

bank_a_cell_count.title: Bank A cell count
bank_a_cell_count.description: Number of cells connected in series in this bank. Cells in parallel count as one.

bank_a_capacity_ah.title: Bank A capacity
bank_a_capacity_ah.description: Capacity of the bank in Ah. For cells connected in series, enter the capacity of a single cell, because a series connection raises the voltage and keeps the Ah the same.

charge_efficiency.title: Charge efficiency
charge_efficiency.description: Share of the charged energy the battery actually stores, from 0 to 1 (0 to 100 %). LiFePO4 cells usually keep about 0.98 (98 %).

battery_chemistry.title: Battery chemistry
battery_chemistry.description: Cell chemistry of the battery. LiFePO4 is the only one supported so far.

soc_curve.title: State-of-charge curve
soc_curve.description: Voltage curve used for the voltage-based SoC estimate.

empty_v_per_cell.title: Empty voltage per cell
empty_v_per_cell.description: Resting voltage per cell at which the battery counts as empty and the counter is set to 0 %. Pick a value your inverter or BMS reaches before it cuts off, otherwise the 0 % calibration never happens.

full_v_per_cell.title: Full voltage per cell
full_v_per_cell.description: Resting voltage per cell at which the battery counts as full and the counter is set to 100 %. If your charger stops below this voltage, the calibration tolerance still lets the 100 % calibration happen.

calibration_tolerance_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance at low current
calibration_tolerance_v_per_cell.description: How far the empty and full thresholds may give way at low current, in volts per cell. At rest the measured voltage is close to the resting voltage, so a reading just short of the threshold still calibrates. At high current the exact threshold applies. 0 keeps the thresholds fixed.

calibration_tolerance_empty_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance, empty side
calibration_tolerance_empty_v_per_cell.description: Tolerance for the empty threshold only. Leave empty to use the shared tolerance, 0 means none. A generous value helps when the BMS or inverter cuts off well above the empty voltage.

calibration_tolerance_full_v_per_cell.title: Calibration tolerance, full side
calibration_tolerance_full_v_per_cell.description: Tolerance for the full threshold only. Leave empty to use the shared tolerance, 0 means none. Keep it small if your charger reaches the full voltage, so a battery that isn't full yet doesn't get set to 100 %.

full_taper_c_rate.title: Tail current for the full calibration (C-rate)
full_taper_c_rate.description: The battery only counts as full when its current at full voltage stays below this C-rate. Leave empty to turn the check off. With solar surplus charging, a small current can also mean little sun, and this check stops the tolerance from calibrating too early. The cell data sheet usually lists this tail current, often around 0.05 C.

internal_resistance_mohm_per_cell.title: Internal resistance per cell
internal_resistance_mohm_per_cell.description: Internal resistance per cell in milliohms, used to correct the voltage under load. Leave empty to use the built-in table. The calibration analysis calculates a suggested value from the recorded calibrations, which you can apply from the open setting suggestions.

bank_b_enabled.title: Bank B present
bank_b_enabled.description: Set to false for installations with only one battery bank. Bank B is then excluded from the current split, the combined state of charge and the imbalance warning.

imbalance_warn_v.title: Bank imbalance warning threshold
imbalance_warn_v.description: Voltage difference between bank A and bank B above which the imbalance warning turns on, in volts. Only used for banks in series.

calibration_hold_s.title: Calibration hold time
calibration_hold_s.description: How long the voltage has to stay past a threshold before the calibration is applied, in seconds.

calibration_grace_s.title: Calibration grace period (s)
calibration_grace_s.description: How long a short dropout may interrupt the hold time without restarting it, in seconds. 0 restarts it on every dropout. If your charger pauses regularly, set this above the pause length. A stale voltage sensor always restarts the hold time.

voltage_soc_mismatch_warn_pct.title: Voltage/coulomb mismatch threshold
voltage_soc_mismatch_warn_pct.description: Difference in percentage points between the voltage-based estimate and the counted state of charge above which a warning can turn on. A generous value avoids false alarms, because the voltage says little in the flat middle of the LiFePO4 curve.

voltage_mismatch_hold_s.title: Voltage/coulomb mismatch hold time
voltage_mismatch_hold_s.description: How long the difference has to stay above the threshold before the warning turns on, in seconds.

state_file.title: State file
state_file.description: Path used to persist the calculated battery state.

stale_input_s.title: Stale input timeout
stale_input_s.description: Seconds without an update after which an input counts as stale.

require_fresh_inputs.title: Require fresh inputs
require_fresh_inputs.description: When on, counting pauses as soon as any input is stale. When off, stale power inputs count as 0 W and voltages keep their last value. The 0 % and 100 % calibration always needs a fresh voltage.

simulation_charger_power_w.title: Simulation charger power
simulation_charger_power_w.description: Charger power in watts used by simulation mode.

simulation_inverter_power_w.title: Simulation inverter power
simulation_inverter_power_w.description: Inverter power in watts used by simulation mode.

charger_power_topic.title: Charger power topic
charger_power_topic.description: Power the charger draws from the mains. Optional if a DC charging input is set.

charger_power_json_key.title: Charger power JSON key
charger_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing charger power in the charger message. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number, as the Trucki sticks publish it; a Shelly reports an object and needs its key here, for example apower.

charger_power_invert.title: Invert charger power
charger_power_invert.description: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging. Negative values are ignored on each side.

inverter_power_topic.title: Inverter power topic
inverter_power_topic.description: Power the inverter delivers on the mains side. Optional if a DC discharging input is set.

inverter_power_json_key.title: Inverter power JSON key
inverter_power_json_key.description: JSON property containing inverter power in the inverter message. Leave empty when the topic carries a bare number, as the Trucki sticks publish it; a Shelly reports an object and needs its key here, for example apower.

inverter_power_invert.title: Invert inverter power
inverter_power_invert.description: Flip the sign of this input. Use the same signed sensor for charging and (inverted) for discharging. Negative values are ignored on each side.

charger_ac_dc_efficiency.title: Charger AC/DC efficiency
charger_ac_dc_efficiency.description: Share of the charger's mains power that reaches the battery, from 0 to 1 (0 to 100 %). Typical chargers are around 0.9 (90 %).

inverter_dc_ac_efficiency.title: Inverter DC/AC efficiency
inverter_dc_ac_efficiency.description: Share of the power the inverter draws from the battery that comes out on the mains side, from 0 to 1 (0 to 100 %). Typical inverters are around 0.9 (90 %).

dc_max_age_s.title: DC measurement maximum age
dc_max_age_s.description: How long a DC reading stays valid, in seconds. After that, the AC reading of the same side takes over again.

topology.title: Bank topology
topology.description: How the two banks are wired. 'parallel' means both banks sit on the same DC bus and form one battery with a single bus voltage; a second voltage measurement is rejected because Kirchhoff forces both terminal voltages equal. 'series' means the banks are stacked, carry the same current and each needs its own voltage measurement.

bank_b_cell_count.title: Bank B cell count
bank_b_cell_count.description: Number of cells connected in series in this bank. Cells in parallel count as one. Banks in parallel must have the same cell count.

bank_b_capacity_ah.title: Bank B capacity
bank_b_capacity_ah.description: Capacity of the bank in Ah. For cells connected in series, enter the capacity of a single cell, because a series connection raises the voltage and keeps the Ah the same. Banks in series must have the same capacity.

bank_b_voltage_topic.title: Bank B voltage topic
bank_b_voltage_topic.description: Voltage of bank B alone, from B+ to B- (the middle tap to the minus of the stack).

bank_b_voltage_json_key.title: Bank B voltage JSON key
bank_b_voltage_json_key.description: JSON property containing battery bank B voltage.

bank_b_voltage_scale.title: Bank B voltage scale
bank_b_voltage_scale.description: Correction factor for the sensor (e.g. a voltage divider). Leave at 1.0 when the sensor reports the real pack voltage. The per-cell conversion happens via the cell count.

bank_a_voltage_measures.title: Bank A sensor measures
bank_a_voltage_measures.description: If the bank A sensor measures the whole stack, bank A is calculated as the stack minus bank B.
